connector.name: MCP Server by multimail.dev
connector.registryDescription: Give your agent its own email address with graduated human oversight, from approval to autonomy.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.multimail.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.multimail. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MULTIMAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Your MultiMail API key (starts with mm_live_). Optional — run without it to create an account first.

env.name: MULTIMAIL_MAILBOX_ID
env.description: Default mailbox ID. If not set, pass mailbox_id to each tool or call list_mailboxes first.
